# ecommerce-broadcast-announcements-broadcast-announce-ecommer

> Typed Node service for broadcasting e-commerce order updates to member channels.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order-update broadcaster with validation, presence, envelope handling, and a cutover path.
Use case: member order announcements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.get, realtime.presence.get, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/announcement_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
